en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ammar Bin Mrwan, from Sama’at Bin Mihran who said,
about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [7:182] We Let them be gradually enticed from whence they know not.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He is the servant who commits the sin and the Bounty is renewed for him along with it. That Bounty distracts him from seeking the Forgiveness from that sin’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ‘Ammar ibn Marwan from Sama’a ibn Mehran who has said the following:

about the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, ‘We gradually lead those who have called Our revelations mere lies to destruction. Their destruction will be such that they will not even notice how it seized them.’ [7:182]
The Imam said, ‘It happens when a servant (of Allah) commits a sin, new bounties come to him which keeps him amused and he overlooks pleading for forgiveness for that sin.’”
